proposed_widenings.name: resource-less magic item activation
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing activation family requires a consumable resource and reset cadence, but this item's command-word transformations are repeatable at will.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use:

proposed_widenings.name: activation precondition for item occupancy
proposed_widenings.justification: The fold-back command is only legal when the transformed vessel has no creatures aboard, and there is no activation-side predicate for that condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard.

proposed_widenings.name: item destruction on transformed form reaching 0 hit points
proposed_widenings.justification: Existing destruction policies only model charge-exhaustion breakage, not destruction caused by a transformed item's vessel form being reduced to 0 HP.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed.

notes: The core transform mechanic itself matches existing surface vocabulary via alter_item_kind on an item attachment, but the current activation and destruction shapes cannot represent this item honestly without inventing a fake resource model.
